segments.name: dietary and energy beverage business
segments.description: Sells the Sure Shot Dietary Supplement and Yerbaé plant-based energy beverages to consumers through Amazon, other e-commerce and retail channels.
segments.evidence: The dietary and energy beverage products generate revenue from the sale of these products through Amazon and other direct channels.

segments.name: digital assets
segments.description: Invests in and holds BONK tokens for appreciation and earns revenue from a revenue sharing agreement tied to Bonk's digital platform.
segments.evidence: The Company has two reportable segments: (i) the dietary and energy beverage business and (ii) digital assets, consisting of investing for growth in the appreciation of the asset.

revenueModel.text: Consumers pay for beverage products sold through Amazon and other direct channels, and the Company earns revenue from a revenue sharing agreement tied to Bonk's digital platform.
revenueModel.evidence: The dietary and energy beverage products generate revenue from the sale of these products through Amazon and other direct channels.

changes.text: In 2025, the Company acquired Yerbaé Brands Corp., adding a premium energy beverage business.
changes.evidence: On June 27, 2025, the Company completed the acquisition of Yerbaé, a premium energy beverage company, in a transaction accounted for as a business combination under ASC 805, Business Combinations.

changes.text: In 2025, the Company entered the digital asset space through the Bonk transaction, creating a new digital assets segment.
changes.evidence: In September 2025, the Company entered into a digital asset transaction with Bonk, a Solana-based cryptocurrency project.

changes.text: In 2024, the Company discontinued Jupiter Wellness's historical product lines, which Caring Brands agreed to commercialize.
changes.evidence: on September 24, 2024, the Company entered into a Separation and Exchange Agreement with its subsidiary Caring Brands, Inc. whereby Caring Brands would commercialize this product line.
